title: Dstruct
tagline: An AI workspace to help web3 founders prepare for incorporation and coordinate legal work.
description: Dstruct explores a clearer path through legal setup for web3 founders. The prototype organizes founder facts, open questions, official references, and an exportable adviser brief. An animated product vision shows how AI could connect incorporation planning with governance and treasury context, helping international teams coordinate their next steps with specialist advisers.
how_its_made: Built with JavaScript, Node.js, and structured JSON records. The working prototype connects a case library, deterministic intake routing, official sources, and JSON or Markdown exports. A Canvas presentation illustrates the proposed web3 workflow. Automated checks cover the data, routing, exports, and server. AI and wallet integrations are part of the product vision.
